scope: Hays County, Texas, iNaturalist place ID 326
criteria: quality_grade=research; captive=false; photos=true; place_id=326; taxon_id=the candidate's iNaturalist taxon ID

definitions.RECORDS_DOCUMENTED: At least one Hays County matching public research-grade record with a photo, currently tagged wild on iNaturalist. This is NOT independent field confirmation.
definitions.NO_MATCHING_PHOTO_RECORDS: No matching public photographed research-grade observations currently flagged wild, despite previous overall research-grade counts.
definitions.API_ERROR: Evidence could not be fetched; not a negative ecological finding.

limitations: Research-grade ID on iNaturalist can still be incorrect, especially among look-alike grasses.
A plant marked wild on iNaturalist might have been planted or have inaccurate location/identification.
The query checks observation metadata and presence of photos, not visual morphology or voucher examination.
A Hays occurrence is not the same as Hays County nativity or evidence of a persistent local population.
Distinct observers counted only within sample, not across all county observations.
Photographs are not downloaded or licensed for reuse by this evidence check.
